ComputingForGeeks is the strongest: it has current prices and timed Immich on a virtual machine, but it says it had none of the NAS boxes to test. Esp32 compares on specs only. The other results compare iPhone backup apps (written by an app developer) or are general photo-NAS affiliate roundups. A focused page that runs Immich on real NAS units could stand out.
